pages.title: Coils
pages.text: Coils are metal blocks placed in a ring around the rotor shaft, in the layers that are not blades. They convert rotor speed into RF and slow the rotor down doing it.

pages.title: The three properties
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Efficiency$(): how much of the rotor's energy becomes RF.$(li)$(thing)Extraction Rate$(): how hard the coil drags on the rotor. Higher pulls more energy per tick but makes the rotor harder to keep at speed.$(li)$(thing)Bonus$(): a multiplier applied on top when the coil is part of a full ring.

pages.title: Starting out
pages.text: Iron is the cheap default. Gold is a straight upgrade, and copper sits between the two.$(br2)None of them are worth optimising around. Build the turbine with iron, then replace the coils once you have a fuel supply that can keep it fed.

pages.title: Ludicrite
pages.text: The best coil the mod ships. High efficiency, a strong extraction rate and a bonus multiplier on top.$(br2)A full ring of ludicrite is the end of the coil progression unless your pack adds something better.

pages.title: Adding your own
pages.text: Like moderators, the coil list is data driven and packs can change it.$(br2)Open $(thing)JEI$() and check the uses for the Turbine Terminal for the accurate list in your pack.
